Since it's summer, and I live in the land of Freedom, we eat hotdogs. Some of you do, too. But you're doing it wrong. I aim to correct that.

Supplies:

6 pk Beer. The good shit. None of that pisswater.

Hotdogs. However many you fucking need. I recommend multiples of 6, because that's how they sell the buns. Get the good, all beef ones, ideally from a butcher shop. If it ain't big enough to be wrecking a coed in a porno, it ain't big enough to put down your throat.

Bacon. In a perfect world, you'd make your own, it's so easy that a retarded chimp could do it. Since you can't meet those standards, get the thick-cut stuff, again, ideally from a butcher. If your hotdogs are big enough, you'll need two strips each. If they aren't, throw them out and get better ones.

Toothpicks. Get the round ones. Those limp-dicked flat ones will break, and then you'll have toothpicks in your food, and end up like that gypsy kid on that one episode of House.

Buns. Get the real thing. These dogs deserve it. I know that at least some of you probably think a peice of bread folded in half is good enough. Have some self-respect.

Condiments. Whatever you like. These are Freedom Hotdogs, eat them with what you want. The Chicago-style Puritans will claim that only mustard, relish, and sauerkraut is acceptable. Because it's goddamn delicious, that's why.

Directions:

First, drink a beer. Savor it. Now you're ready.

Open another beer. Wrap the hotdogs with the bacon. Tight coils, no gaps. Don't get sloppy. Shove one of those toothpicks into the end where you started. Angle that little bastard so it's mostly buried, if you want these things to cook properly. I shouldn't have to tell you to leave enough to pull it out later, but I probably do.

Around the halfway point, you're going to need another strip of bacon. This is a good thing. Overlap with the first, ram another toothpick in that thing, continue wrapping. Finish it off with another toothpick. If the bacon allows it, you want to offset them little fuckers.

Start in on the third beer. Get your skillet hot. I assume you have a good cast-iron one. If your grandma didn't love you, non-stick will have to suffice.

At this point, those of you who aren't functionally retarded are asking "Why aren't we heating up the grill. Hotdogs are better on the grill." Normally, you would be right. These aren't normal hotdogs. These are the best damn hotdogs you've ever eaten. Do as you're told, and don't fuck it up.

While those are cooking, go heat up those buns. Use your head. Oven, grill, whatever. I don't give a shit.

Finish your weiners, ram 'em into those hot buns, pop open number five, and slather' em with whatever condiments you prefer. Again, I prefer sriracha and slaw, but do as you please. If you aren't incompetent, you made some sides in between everything else. Or not. These sons-a-bitches are good enough to stand alone. Eat. Enjoy. Thank me.

Make sure you save that bacon fat you cooked off. Use it to cook anything else. It makes everything better.
